name: 8BitDo Retro Mechanical Keyboard
notes: 245-byte report descriptor of the keyboard interface (interface 2) of a real 8BitDo Retro Mechanical Keyboard, read with usbhid-dump from the device: https://github.com/hrvach/deskhop/issues/57. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
